classification.difficultyReason: Count deposits across inclusive calendar years, model their accumulated values as a geometric series and calculate its sum.

content.prompt: Jodie starts work in 2019 and puts $\$1000$ in a superannuation fund at the end of the year. She keeps putting in this same amount at the end of every year until she retires at the end of 2036. If interest is paid at 10% p.a., calculate how much Jodie will have when she retires. Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
There are 18 end-of-year deposits from 2019 to 2036 inclusive.

End of 2019: $1000$

End of 2020: $1000(1.10)+1000$

End of 2036: $1000(1.10)^{17}+1000(1.10)^{16}+\cdots+1000$

This is a geometric series with $a=1000$, $R=1.10$ and $n=18$.

$$\begin{align*}FV&=\frac{a(R^n-1)}{R-1}\\FV&=\frac{1000(1.10^{18}-1)}{1.10-1}\\FV&\approx\$45\,599.17\end{align*}$$
